definitions.explanation: A document that lists items, amounts, or details in a breakdown format. Used for pay slips, medical bills, utility bills, credit card statements, and patent specifications.

examples.japanese: {給与|きゅうよ}{明細書|めいさいしょ}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{医療費|いりょうひ}の{明細書|めいさいしょ}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I received a detailed statement of medical expenses.

examples.japanese: クレジットカードの{明細書|めいさいしょ}に{身|み}に{覚|おぼ}えのない{請求|せいきゅう}があったので、カード{会社|がいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}した。
examples.english: There was an unfamiliar charge on my credit card statement, so I contacted the card company.

notes:
USAGE:
{明細書|めいさいしょ} is a common business and daily-life term for any document that provides a detailed breakdown. The shorter form {明細|めいさい} is also frequently used.

Common types of {明細書|めいさいしょ}:
- {給与|きゅうよ}{明細書|めいさいしょ}: pay slip, salary statement
- {医療費|いりょうひ}{明細書|めいさいしょ}: medical expense statement
- クレジットカード{明細書|めいさいしょ}: credit card statement
- {特許|とっきょ}{明細書|めいさいしょ}: patent specification

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a detailed statement
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check a statement
- {明細書|めいさいしょ}を{保管|ほかん}する: to keep a statement on file
